# Paths excluded from the TruffleHog secret scan. One regular expression per
# line, matched against the file path (not shell globs). Used by
# .github/workflows/main.yml via --exclude-paths.
#
# Keep this list as short as possible: every entry is a place the scanner is
# blind. Each entry needs a reason.

# Packaged plugin and skill bundles. They are archives built from source that
# is already scanned, so they only duplicate findings from their sources.
^plugins/s1-secops-skills/dist/

# Hyperautomation action catalog. The last column of its tables is a
# public_action_id (a vendor action-pack UUID, not a credential), and the
# Opsgenie detector matches the UUID shape. See the table header in the file.
^plugins/s1-secops-skills/skills/hyperautomation/references/integration-catalog\.md$
